description: The contacts a campaign writes to, the latest added first, a page at a time. `q` matches every word against the address, the name and the company, case ignored. Each lead says where its address stands for this campaign now, as its next step would be judged: `standing` is `eligible` (may get it), `review` (a fresh check said risky or couldn't tell, and the campaign's switch for it is off), `held` (waits for a fresh check) or `excluded` (never written to), and `standingReason` says why. A lead a person sent anyway in the console reads `eligible` and carries `sendAnyway`: who, when, and what it overrode. Filter with `standing`.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_campaign_leads
title: List a campaign's leads
